findings.highlight: No, it is just a scream
findings.evidenceJa: それは、単純に悲鳴だった
findings.governingReading: It was simply a scream
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts a corrective “No” where the narration directly identifies the sensation.

findings.highlight: Collection from the people
findings.evidenceJa: 市民からの搾取
findings.governingReading: exploitation of the city’s inhabitants
findings.explanation: Caster’s predation on civilians is euphemized as collection.

findings.highlight: she did not intend to do the forbidden
findings.evidenceJa: 決して禁を破る気はなかった
findings.governingReading: she never intended to break those taboos
findings.explanation: The object and action collapse into malformed English.

findings.highlight: the skills that labeled her a “witch”
findings.evidenceJa: 自らを“魔女”に貶めた術
findings.governingReading: the arts that debased her into a “witch”
findings.explanation: Caster’s moral self-degradation becomes an externally applied label.

findings.highlight: She only created disasters that caused people to destroy themselves
findings.evidenceJa: 自己に返る呪いだけで、災いを呼ぶ
findings.governingReading: she called down calamity only through curses that recoiled upon their victims
findings.explanation: The curse mechanism and Caster’s chosen restraint disappear.

findings.highlight: It is natural for me to go crazy for something
findings.evidenceJa: 気が違うのは当然です
findings.governingReading: it is only natural to lose one’s mind over it
findings.explanation: The claim of madness becomes the English idiom for intense enthusiasm.

findings.highlight: start a second life as a “human”
findings.evidenceJa: 人の世に干渉できる『人間』として第二の生
findings.governingReading: a second life as a “human” able to intervene in the human world
findings.explanation: The practical power restored by embodiment disappears.

findings.highlight: For nowshe lets her guard down
findings.evidenceJa: 今だけ一時だけあらゆる警戒を解いて
findings.governingReading: just for this moment, she releases every precaution
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses “now” to the subject, while total suspension of vigilance is weakened.

findings.highlight: A chanced meeting
findings.evidenceJa: その偶然
findings.governingReading: that chance encounter
findings.explanation: The central encounter is described with the malformed phrase “chanced meeting.”

findings.highlight: her limbs had turned white from the winter cold
findings.evidenceJa: 白い手足は冬の雨に凍えていた
findings.governingReading: her white limbs shivered in the winter rain
findings.explanation: Caster’s established coloring becomes a result of cold, and her shivering disappears.

findings.highlight: even the amount of magical energy was unlike her
findings.evidenceJa: その魔力さえ、面影は皆無だった
findings.governingReading: even her magical power retained no trace of its former state
findings.explanation: The obliteration of Caster’s former magical presence becomes an awkward comparison of quantity to a person.

findings.highlight: SheServant Caster
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女キャスターのサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: she—the Servant Caster
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses the pronoun and class name.

findings.highlight: as compensation for obtaining freedom
findings.evidenceJa: 自由を得た代償として
findings.governingReading: as the price she paid for gaining freedom
findings.explanation: Caster’s lethal cost is mislabeled as recompense.

findings.highlight: she betrayed her vulgar Master
findings.evidenceJa: 下卑たマスターの寝首をかいた
findings.governingReading: she cut down her vulgar Master while he was unsuspecting
findings.explanation: Caster’s concrete murder of her first Master is euphemized as betrayal.

findings.highlight: the other Masters to kill each other
findings.evidenceJa: 他のマスター達の自滅
findings.governingReading: the other Masters to destroy themselves
findings.explanation: Mutual killing is inserted where her Master merely waits for rivals’ self-destruction.

findings.highlight: filled the man’s conceit
findings.evidenceJa: 男の自尊心を満たし続けた
findings.governingReading: continually gratified the man’s pride
findings.explanation: Malformed collocation obscures Caster’s calculated management of his ego.

findings.highlight: In other wordsto lose one’s Master
findings.evidenceJa: つまり自らの依り代
findings.governingReading: In other words, losing one’s vessel
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses “words” and “to” in a central Servant-existence explanation.

findings.highlight: passport to this age
findings.evidenceJa: 現世へのパスポート
findings.governingReading: passport to the present world
findings.explanation: The Master’s metaphysical anchoring function is shifted from this world to this historical period.

findings.highlight: the gods
findings.evidenceJa: 神という選定者
findings.governingReading: the selector called a god
findings.explanation: A singular divine agent who chooses the hero becomes an unspecified pantheon.

findings.highlight: cut apart her own brother
findings.evidenceJa: 弟を八つ裂きにし
findings.governingReading: tore her younger brother into eight pieces
findings.explanation: The number and extremity of Medea’s coerced act disappear.

findings.highlight: show them the ugliness of the wishes they demanded of her
findings.evidenceJa: 真実その姿になって思い知らせてやろう
findings.governingReading: truly become what they exalted and force them to see how ugly it was
findings.explanation: Medea’s deliberate embodiment of society’s invented witch is replaced by ugliness in the people’s wishes.

findings.highlight: people do not know their ugliness
findings.evidenceJa: おまえたちがおまえたちの咎を知らない
findings.governingReading: you do not know your own guilt
findings.explanation: Medea’s accusation of unrecognized culpability becomes aesthetic ugliness.

findings.highlight: barely able to stand
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れそうな意識のまま
findings.governingReading: with consciousness on the verge of collapse
findings.explanation: A failing mental state becomes physical balance.

findings.highlight: she was covered in blood
findings.evidenceJa: 腰から下は返り血で真っ赤
findings.governingReading: she was crimson with spattered blood from the waist down
findings.explanation: The location and nature of the bloodstaining disappear.

findings.highlight: It is obvious what such a person did
findings.evidenceJa: この人間が何をするかは明白だった
findings.governingReading: it was obvious what this human would do
findings.explanation: The expected response of the approaching stranger is misread as a past act by the bloodied woman.

findings.highlight: that manthe man who she met in the woods
findings.evidenceJa: あの人間林で出会った男
findings.governingReading: that man—the human she met in the woods
findings.explanation: A duplicated, fused “manthe man” breaks the moment Kuzuki reappears.

findings.highlight: he followed whatever whim took him
findings.evidenceJa: 与えられた事を成す
findings.governingReading: he carries out whatever is assigned to him
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s defining lack of self-directed purpose becomes impulsive whim.

findings.highlight: the best protection
findings.evidenceJa: 鉄壁の守り
findings.governingReading: an impregnable defense
findings.explanation: Caster’s absolute defensive advantage is weakened to a vague superlative.

findings.highlight: She would have been fine with it
findings.evidenceJa: なければないで諦めがついた類
findings.governingReading: without them, she simply could have resigned herself to the end
findings.explanation: Medea’s readiness to accept extinction becomes emotional contentment.

findings.highlight: she feels that everything she does is not going well
findings.evidenceJa: 自分のやる事はみな上手くいかないのだ、と彼女は嘆息した
findings.governingReading: she sighs that nothing she does ever goes right
findings.explanation: Caster’s audible, weary self-judgment disappears.

findings.highlight: They do not get along well
findings.evidenceJa: かみ合わないお互いの存在
findings.governingReading: their two existences fail to mesh
findings.explanation: The existential mismatch in their one-way bond becomes ordinary interpersonal friction.

findings.highlight: We have had nothing to fear
findings.evidenceJa: もう敵なんていない
findings.governingReading: there are no enemies left
findings.explanation: Caster’s roster claim becomes a claim about subjective fear.

findings.highlight: Archer’s words
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの軽口
findings.governingReading: Archer’s flippant remark
findings.explanation: The light, provocative manner that makes Archer’s statement hard to read disappears.

findings.highlight: A righteous hero can only be summoned by righteous people
findings.evidenceJa: 正しい英雄という者はね、正しい人間にしか使役できない
findings.governingReading: a proper hero can be commanded only by a proper human being
findings.explanation: A claim about who can successfully wield a hero becomes a rule about who can summon one.

findings.highlight: summon anyone with powers
findings.evidenceJa: 力のある人間霊なら、誰であろうと汲み上げる
findings.governingReading: draw up any human spirit that possesses power
findings.explanation: The Grail’s selection of empowered human spirits broadens to any powered being.

findings.highlight: Put that into consideration when you talk to me
findings.evidenceJa: それを肝に銘じて口をききなさい
findings.governingReading: engrave that fact upon your heart before you speak
findings.explanation: Caster’s severe command becomes weak, malformed managerial advice.

findings.highlight: Saber surrenders
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの陥落
findings.governingReading: Saber’s fall into subjugation
findings.explanation: Caster’s coercive takeover is made into Saber’s voluntary capitulation.

findings.highlight: Butthe reason will go away
findings.evidenceJa: だが終わってしまえば
findings.governingReading: But once it ends, the reason will disappear
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses the adversative and article.

findings.highlight: Her hard work
findings.evidenceJa: 長かった疲労
findings.governingReading: her long ordeal of exhaustion
findings.explanation: Caster’s accumulated depletion becomes productive effort.
